3. Description of the Proposed FHWA Action
This highway improvement will provide a 1.5 mile direct freeway-airport connection, on new location within Corridor #5, between existing Interstate Route 94 and General Mitchell Field. This connection will improve service to the airline terminal, provide access to the proposed cargo area, and will divert airport oriented traffic from the congested surface arterial system. It will be in conformance with national policy of integrating ground and air transportation by directly connecting Milwaukee County's freeway system with General Mitchell Field, the region's only scheduled air transport airport. This facility will also provide an opportunity for improved hus rapid transit to the area as an alternative to continued automobile use.
The project is located in the City of Milwaukee, Milwaukee County. See Figures 1 and 2.
